sourceGaps: 2004T2: The original catalyst mechanism contains overprinted labels. The separate answer sheet is absent; the printed key and native decision form are retained.
2004T3: The printed exothermic disproportionation enthalpy and marked NO stability answer are contradictory; both remain literal. All original diagrams/table retained.
2004T4: All original three-dimensional products, argyrodite stoichiometry and isotope/vibration formula retained.

2004T5: The printed key repeats the mitochondrion diameter as 1 m while calculations use micrometres; terminal exponent printing also conflicts with earlier calculation. The 5.2 key literally prints 6.3 × 10⁶ although its displayed product is 0.0038 × 0.00165. No source correction.
2004T6: 6.4 decision statements appear in the printed key; all stereochemical alternatives, native truth form and complete reverse mechanism retained.
2004T7: Separate answer-sheet group/form content appears in the key; Newman/sawhorse and Fischer alternatives and alternative hydride model belong to the same whole.
2004T8: Native concentration units in the key conflict with the question. Preserve the block-polymer graphic, marked forms and complete density calculation.
